name: Sigil of Strom
summary: At Hammerfall, Zengu seeks the sigils that guard Trol'kalar, Lord Ignaeus Trollbane's sword. The Syndicate took the Sigil of Strom, and one of its agents in Stromgarde likely carries it.

sections.title: The Legacy of Trollbane
sections.body: Long ago, Lord Ignaeus of Strom, called Trollbane, was the Arathorian Empire's ablest foe in its war against the trolls. He wielded Trol'kalar in battle. In the trolls' old tongue, its name means troll slayer. Now Trollbane's sons are weakened, and their stronghold lies in ruins.

sections.title: The First Sigil
sections.body: Several sigils guard Trol'kalar, and Stromgarde's survivors each took some. Zengu says they must all be recovered. The Syndicate seized the first, the Sigil of Strom. Zengu believes one of its agents in Stromgarde holds it. Bring the sigil back to Zengu at Hammerfall.

faq.answer: At Hammerfall in Arathi, Zengu is gathering the sigils that guard Trol'kalar, Lord Ignaeus Trollbane's sword.
Trol'kalar means troll slayer in the trolls' ancient tongue. Lord Ignaeus of Strom, called Trollbane, rode into battle against the trolls with the sword.

faq.q: Why is the Sigil of Strom needed?
faq.answer: Several sigils guard Trol'kalar, and Stromgarde's survivors divided them among themselves. Zengu wants them all, beginning with the Sigil of Strom.

faq.q: Who holds the Sigil of Strom?
aliases: who has the sigil of strom
where is the sigil of strom
faq.answer: The Syndicate took the Sigil of Strom. One of its agents in Stromgarde is most likely carrying it.
